description: Collaborative work management platform for tracking projects, managing workflows, and organizing data in spreadsheet-like sheets.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public apps, and API access tokens (bearer tokens) generated from the Smartsheet account UI for private/personal use.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a Smartsheet account and generate API access tokens or register apps via the developer portal self-serve.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering sheets, rows, columns, reports, users, workspaces, folders, attachments, and webhooks.
mcp_notes: Official Smartsheet MCP server provided by Smartsheet for AI integration.
rationale: Smartsheet provides a robust public REST API, self-serve developer access, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready for agent toolkits today.
